bus.description: Bus number of the specific GPU to monitor. Derived from lspci output (e.g., 1 for 01:00.0). Leave null to let radeontop autodetect.

dump_file.description: Path to file to append data to, or '-' for stdout. Leave null for interactive mode.

dump_interval.description: Number of seconds to wait between data output when in dump mode.

limit.description: Quit after dumping this many lines. Only valid in dump mode.

use_mem.description: Force the use of /dev/mem path, in case autodetection fails. Useful for proprietary drivers.

drm_path.description: Open the DRM device node specified by this path (e.g., /dev/dri/card0). If used, --bus and --mem are ignored.

ticks.description: How many times per second to sample the data.
